member.name: T:EventSources.EventSource
member.summary:
An EventSource is an abstraction that provides all the functionality that is needed by PerfView's Events viewer GUI. Anything that implements this interface can be viewed in the Events Viewer.
The main functionality that subclasses implement is the 'Events' enumeration.
